draft.subject: Your Slack and SSO questions
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks for the notes on the Slack integration and on SSO -- both tickets are still open on our side, and I'm tracking them with the team so you get a clear answer rather than a guess. For context, SSO is available on the Team plan.

In the meantime, I don't want those to hold up the rest of your setup. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so one real Cedar Studio project is the quickest way to see how it fits.

Want a short call this week? I'll walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
